newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber softens in noon trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber softens in noon trade.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 rubber prices fell in by noon on Wednesday after deals in Jambi and Medan, traders said.

"We are frustrated this morning because offer prices are falling like this. Many traders are reluctant to sell and we are still waiting to find out what's going to happen later in the afternoon," said one trader.

Traders said deals were done at 46.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan for August shipment and at 45.50 fob Pontianak. Offer prices were quoted at 46.00 fob Palembang, Surabaya and Padang and at 45.50 fob Pontianak.
"Buyers bid at 45.75 in Palembang, but traders did not want to sell because such prices are not profitable for us," said another trader.
Some traders attributed the decline to developments in Thailand, where the government has intervened to prop up prices.
